purpose: Shared rules for every FYPMS prompt. Read once per conversation; do not restate.
token_rules: Never open docs/fypms-docs.md whole. Find a part with: grep -n 'FR-02' docs/fypms-docs.md, then sed -n 'START,ENDp'.
Model list and access summary: docs/models.md. Document types: src/types/firestore.ts.
Edit files directly. Do not paste whole files in chat and do not repeat this prompt back.
Do only `build`. Anything in `out_of_scope` belongs to a later prompt.
Verify with the narrowest command (single file/test). Never run the whole suite after a small change.
Before diagnosing a bug, grep docs/bugs.md for the same symptom.

layout.tests: co-located *.test.ts for unit; tests/rules/*.rules.test.ts; tests/server/*.test.ts (Admin SDK on emulator); e2e/*.spec.ts
layout.pages: src/app/<route>/page.tsx (routes sit directly under src/app per spec section 11)

model_layer.schema: Zod create schema `.strict()`; update schema = partial of updatable fields only. Server-managed fields (id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, counters, status transitions) never appear in input schemas.
model_layer.repo: `import 'server-only'`; Admin SDK; typed get/list/create/update helpers; no business rules; strip undefined before writes; serverTimestamp for created_at/updated_at.
model_layer.action: 'use server' -> requireUser(idToken, roles) -> Zod parse -> mutate (runTransaction when read-then-write) -> writeAudit -> notify. Return {ok:true,...} or {ok:false,errors}; catch ZodError and HttpError. Export only async functions. `export const runtime = 'nodejs'`.
model_layer.rules: Only touch firestore.rules when the prompt says so; add the smallest block; use isMember()/hasAnyRole()/isTeamMember()/isAssignedSupervisor(); never loosen existing blocks; add or update a rules test for every change.
model_layer.registry: Add or update the model's row in docs/models.md (model, collection, access, code location, date).
model_layer.client_reads: Client components read Firestore only where the prompt says (onSnapshot with unsubscribe); everything else is RSC + repo.

ui: Light mode only, HTU blue and white; semantic tokens from fypms-ui-design-system; no dark: classes; no hex in components.
Reuse shadcn components and src/components/common (StatusBadge, EmptyState, LockedCard, PageHeader, BentoCard, LifecycleStepper).
Every page: loading.tsx skeleton, empty state with CTA, error state, role-gated content; forms use React Hook Form + Zod + sonner toasts.
Touch targets >= 44px, visible focus ring, aria-live for live scores/toasts.
security: Never trust client input for uid, role or course_id; derive from the verified token or server docs.
firebase-admin only in server modules; never in client components or middleware.
Enforce category integrity (course_id) wherever teams, supervisors or panels are matched.
quality_gates: no invented test data (users, emails, phones) outside fixtures/
layout checks at 375/768/1280 for UI prompts
on_error: If the fypms-fix-bug skill is installed, use its loop (classify A/B/C/D, reproduce, fix, prove, record in docs/bugs.md). Class B (the spec, a skill or a prompt was wrong) goes to fypms-spec-change first.
Match the error text against fypms-testing and fypms-firestore-data guidance first, then reproduce with the narrowest command.
State the root cause in one sentence before editing; smallest fix; re-run the same command.
Never fix a rules error by loosening rules; never skip or delete a failing test; max 3 attempts then report status 'blocked' with hypotheses.
assumption_policy: When the spec is silent, follow the prompt's `assumptions`. Otherwise pick the simplest option and list it in `assumptions_made`. Ask the user only if blocked.
test_data: Only fixtures/testusers.json and fixtures/staff-profiles.json (through fixtures/index.ts) may supply users, students, staff, groups or contacts. Never invent or generate them.
Automated tests use the test emulator only (firebase.test.json, project demo-fypms-test, Auth 9199, Firestore 8180). The dev emulator (demo-fypms, 9099/8080) holds only seeded fixture data.
Seed and check scripts are idempotent and exit unless the emulator host variables are set; tests clean up after themselves.
ui_qa: After building a page or shared component, check 375, 768 and 1280 px for each role that can open it (seed:base data) and add or extend a Playwright layout assertion (fypms-ui-qa).
One indicator per state (never border + ring + outline together); tabs sit above their content; tables scroll inside their own container; no element hidden by the dev badge.
